description_en: Queries the hotline agent status in the Cloud Customer Service System by AICCS instance ID and agent account name.
description_zh: 根据AICCS实例ID、坐席账号名称查询悉犀客服工作台热线坐席状态
kebab_example: aliyun aiccs get-hotline-agent-status --instance-id ccc_xp_pre-cn-000 --account-name username@example.com --api-version 2019-10-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetHotlineAgentStatus

parameters.help_en:
AICCS instance ID.  
You can obtain it from Instance Management in the left-side navigation pane of the Artificial Intelligence Cloud Call Service console (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview).
parameters.help_zh: AICCS实例ID。 您可以在智能联络中心控制台 (https://aiccs.console.aliyun.com/overview)左侧导航栏的实例管理中获取
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: Agent account name, which is the phone number or mailbox entered during account registration. It is unique within the instance.
parameters.help_zh: 坐席账号名称，即账号注册时填写的手机或邮箱。实例内唯一。
parameters.name: account_name

Code.description_en: Status code. A value of "Success" indicates that the request succeeded.
Code.description_zh: 状态码。返回Success表示请求成功

Data.description_en:
Agent status. Valid values:  
Offline  
Idle  
Post-processing  
In Call  
Break - Rest  
Break - Meal  
Break - Meeting  
Break - Training  
Break - Coaching
Data.description_zh:
坐席状态。取值：
离线
空闲
话后处理
通话中
小休-休息
小休-就餐
小休-会议
小休-培训
小休-辅导

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the API call succeeded. Valid values:  
true: Succeeded.  
false: Failed.
Success.description_zh:
调用接口是否成功。取值：
true：成功。
false：失败
